description: Write a markdown note into the vault. REFUSED unless the human enabled writes ("Let AI edit my notes" in UnClick's Obsidian vault settings, or OBSIDIAN_VAULT_WRITABLE=1; the vault is read-only for AI by default). When allowed: create by default, append/overwrite explicit, the previous version is always backed up first, and writes never leave the vault or enter folders marked .ai-private.
name: obsidian_save_note
